title: Observability Weekly - 2026-04-20
body:
OBSERVABILITY WEEKLY — 2026-04-20

Attendees: Aisha Patel (owner), Marco Rivera, Priya Kapoor, Liam O'Neill, Sofia Martinez, oncall: Marco (week)

Summary:
- Focus this week: tracing sampling improvements, dashboard refresh for cost telemetry, rollout of tail-latency alerting and continued post-mortem work from 2026-04-18 partial outage.
- Completed: prototype of per-model GPU cost dashboard, tracing header sanitizer for PII suppression, basic anomaly detector for token-level cost spikes.
- Blockers: rollout gating for tracing sampling due to compatibility issue with legacy customer headers; billing API quota causing occasional missing metrics in cost dashboard ingestion.

Highlights / Decisions:
- Tracing sampling: decided to adopt adaptive sampling that preserves 100% sampling for errors and high-latency traces, 5%-20% for normal traffic depending on model and route. Marco to land RFC by EOD Monday (JIRA-OBS-475).
- Cost telemetry dashboard: new per-model GPU cost tile will be promoted to prod next Wednesday (2026-04-22) behind a feature flag. Priya will coordinate feature flag and notify SRE runbook.
- Tail-latency alerting: threshold updated to p95>250ms OR p99>600ms for text-gen endpoints; alerts will page oncall after 3 occurrences in 10 minutes.

Action items (owners):
- Aisha: Finalize rollout plan for tracing sampling (include rollback steps, compatibility test matrix) — due 2026-04-22.
- Marco: Land tracing header sanitizer PR and add e2e test that validates PII stripping — PR #312, due 2026-04-21.
- Priya: Wire feature-flag for cost dashboard and create communication to customers using dedicated capacity (email + console banner) — due 2026-04-21.
- Liam: Investigate billing API quota errors with cloud provider and propose mitigation (backoff + buffer ingest) — due 2026-04-23.
- Sofia: Flesh out anomaly detector thresholds for token-cost spikes, add synthetic tests — due 2026-04-24.

Standups / Individual notes:
- Aisha: Worked on RCA doc for 2026-04-18 partial outage (link in runbook). Noted main root cause: cascading metrics ingestion backlog + adaptive autoscaler throttling. Working on formal mitigation for ingestion buffer.
- Marco: Implemented header sanitizer; discovered one legacy client sending base64-encoded JSON in X-User-Meta header which requires extra parsing. Added test cases.
- Priya: Dashboard prototype complete; UX feedback from Product shows need to surface per-deployment (hosted vs dedicated) cost split. Will add a toggle.
- Liam: Running load tests against new tail-latency alerting; reproduces flakiness on specific sequence lengths (long-context). Created ticket to add sequence-length bucketing.
- Sofia: Built initial ML rules for anomaly detection (z-score + rate-of-change). Needs labeled historical incidents to tune false-positive rate.

Incidents / Post-mortem status:
- 2026-04-18 partial outage: RCA draft in OBS runbook. Action items: increase ingest buffer + add backpressure signals to autoscaler + improve alerting on ingestion lag. Aisha to drive.

Tracing updates:
- Adaptive sampling RFC accepted in principle; will implement in the agent and gateway layers. Key compatibility considerations: legacy headers, vendor tracing IDs, and cross-region trace stitching.
- Jaeger/OTEL: upgraded collector in staging to v1.12.2; seeing ~12% lower CPU for same throughput. Plan to schedule controlled upgrade to prod on 2026-04-26.
- Correlation IDs: adding route-level metadata to traces to help tie requests to rollout flags and model variants. Will include as low-cardinality tags only.

Dashboards / Metrics:
- New tiles added to the Observability Console: per-model GPU cost (hourly), token-cost per route, ingestion-lag heatmap, tail-latency distribution by sequence-length.
- Need to add annotations for release rollouts (A/B, canary) so spikes can be correlated with rollouts. Priya to prototype.

Cost telemetry:
- Early results from cost per-token pipeline show 6% delta between quantized and float model variants for r-agents workload; finance asked for weekly digest. Agreed to send a short weekly summary to finance and product.
- Billing API quota: intermittent 429s causing missing windows. Liam to add retry/backoff and temporary cache for last-known rates. Also exploring alternative ingest endpoint with higher quota.

Operational / Runbook changes:
- Added procedure for ingestion-lag alerting to runbook (OBS-RUNBOOK-1).
- Oncall playbook updated to include steps for paging billing provider and toggling cost-dashboard feature flag.

Risks / Blockers:
- Legacy client header parsing may increase CPU on frontends if not optimized — risk of increased cost during rollout.
- Billing API stability is an external dependency; we need a fallback ingest path to avoid missing cost telemetry windows.

Roadmap / Next week:
- Finish sampling rollout and e2e tests.
- Promote per-model GPU cost dashboard behind feature flag and monitor for data completeness for 72 hours.
- Schedule Jaeger collector prod upgrade and confirm rollback steps.
- Tune anomaly detector thresholds with labeled incidents.

Notes / Questions:
- Should sampling keep a higher floor (10%) for long-tail enterprise customers to preserve debugability? Action: product/solutions to weigh in.
- Who owns customer communication for cost-dashboard changes for Dedicated customers? (Priya + CS suggested).

Appendix / Links:
- Runbook: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/OBS/pages/876543/Observability+Runbook
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/observability/pull/312
- Tickets: JIRA-OBS-458, JIRA-OBS-475

End of notes.
